messages:
pak: FYI ap-southeast1 tiny-gpu jobs seeing a wave of preempts since 03:50 UTC. looks like nodes with 'gpu.orphan=true' were evicted despite affinity
anya: i grabbed scheduler logs, seems autoscaler considered those nodes deletable even though pods had nodeAffinity to gpu.orphan=true
ben: paste? wondering if predicate rename/label change caused the check to miss
anya: snippet: ```E0321 03:49:58 scale_down.go:172] Node gpu-node-apse1-88 eligible for removal: occupancy=0 RemovePodsViolatesNodeAffinity=false```
ben: RemovePodsViolatesNodeAffinity=false is wrong, those pods should have kept the node non-deletable. did we rename the label in the pod spec?
infra-bot: config-change: node-label-standardization applied (node label key gpu-orphan -> gpu.orphan) at 03:30 UTC (change-id: lbl-2026-03-21-7)
pak: that label standardization explains it — autoscaler predicate still checks the old key `gpu-orphan`. nodes looked empty -> scale-down -> evictions
ops-bot: action created: AUTOSCALE-404 investigate label-key mismatch (assigned to ben).
ben: mitigation: paused cluster-autoscaler in ap-southeast1 and applied node annotation `no-scale-down=true` to affected nodes. also temporarily bumped warmpool-min 2->6 for 20m
anya: metrics: pod_evictions jumped 2 -> 34 in 6m. after pause + warmpool bump evictions down to 6 -> trending down :thumbsup:
pak: cost note: 20m bump projected ~+$2.6k for Dedicated commit; short window so acceptable
ben: next steps: 1) hotfix autoscaler predicate to read both `gpu-orphan` and `gpu.orphan` keys; 2) roll back label standardization or do a coordinated two-step rename; 3) add rollout guard for node-label-standardization changes so autoscaler predicates are validated in canary
anya: I'll upload kubelet events and scheduler traces to AUTOSCALE-404 for postmortem. also recommend an alert for "scale-down removing nodes with non-empty nodeAffinity"
pak: recap: cause = label-key rename mismatch -> autoscaler missed nodeAffinity -> unwanted scale-down -> evictions; mitigation = pause autoscaler + taint/annotation + warmpool bump; follow-ups created. thanks everyone.
